ladder.why: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 3 points better, in a game of about 220 points. team.reason: No option is priced in 2.00-2.10, and ORL to win at 1.88 is the only real Winamax price on the shortlist (the model's ORL +2.0 and DEN -8.0 prices are estimates), so the desk takes the real price on the same side. Detroit are without Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson, and Cade Cunningham is only probable with knee soreness; Orlando's Paolo Banchero is out, but he has played only two games this season.
